title: Data Is Not a Decision
altText: Official NIST AI RMF MAP 2.2 excerpt requiring documentation of system knowledge limits and how output may be used and overseen by humans making decisions.
caption: NIST AI RMF MAP 2.2 distinguishes system output from the human decisions and subsequent actions it informs.
credit: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, p. 26. Republished courtesy of NIST.
claimBoundary: Supports separating output from decision and documenting human use and oversight; it does not prove the Build 008 interface produces correct decisions.
noEndorsement: Use only the exact document treatment under its recorded terms. Exclude logos, seals, people and third-party material; attribution does not imply that National Institute of Standards and Technology endorses RN or Build 008.
